cases.name: lost_ack_observation
cases.retry: Send the identical command envelope again, or call GetCommandReceipt for the same commandId.

cases.name: pending_command_receipt
cases.nextAction: Poll GetCommandReceipt using the same commandId; do not generate a replacement write.

cases.name: stale_version
cases.nextAction: Read the plan execution snapshot and obtain renewed user intent before issuing a new command.

cases.name: ordered_offline_delivery
cases.invariant: Server sequence orders receipt; late, gap, and correction observations never transition a plan or checkpoint.

cases.name: bounded_local_queue
cases.invariant: The exact AppendObservation envelope and commandId remain queued in FIFO order; only local state is durable, and no lifecycle command is queued or auto-replayed.
